questions.question: **Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word. **
questions.solution:
The erroneous spelling is 'Occular'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

 
• The correct spelling for the word is *ocular *which means of or connected with the eyes or vision.
 
• The meanings of the other options are as follows - 
 
 
• Martinet - a person who demands complete obedience; a strict disciplinarian.
 
• Congenital - (of a disease or physical abnormality) present from birth.
 
• Phlegmatic - (of a person) having an unemotional and stolidly calm disposition.
 
 
 
• Hence, option 4 is the correct answer.

questions.solution: The correct answer is **'cannopies'.** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The correct spelling would be **'canopies'.** • **Canopy**__**: ** **A cover that hangs or spreads above something (चँदवा, छत्र, वितान)** __ • **​E.g.__**- The highest branches in the rainforest form a dense **canopy.** **​**Hence, the correct answer is **'option 1'.** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** __ • **Tassels**__**: A group of short threads or ropes held together at one end, used as a hanging decoration on hats, curtains, furniture, etc.** • __**Dampened**__**: to make something slightly wet** • __**Trickle**__**: To go somewhere slowly and gradually.** 31:T6c6,

questions.question: **Direction: Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word.**
questions.solution:
The correct answer is “__Messanger__”.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Out of all the options, the incorrectly spelt word is "Messanger".
 
• Its correct spelling is **"Messenger"**.
 
• Now, let us see the meaning of "Messenger".
 
 
• Messenger: a person who carries a message or is employed to carry messages.
 
 
 
• Hence, the correct answer is “Messenger”.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

**Let’s see the meaning of other given words**:

 
 

 
 
**Word**

 
 
 
**Meaning**

 
 
 

 
 
Immediate

 
 
 
occurring or done at once; instant.

 
 
 

 
 
Massage

 
 
 
the rubbing and kneading of muscles and joints of the body with the hands, especially to relieve tension or pain.

 
 
 

 
 
Amass

 
 
 
gather together or accumulate over a period of time.

 
 
 

​

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9074044cf96dc1d09ca89eac99180c3d7440ade1b364d09d47931959bf693cc8.png] **__Confusion Points__**

 
• There can be some confusion among the words** "Massage"**, **"Amass"** and **"Messanger"** to identify their correct spelling.
 
• **"Massage"** and **"Message"**, both are correct words but different in meaning.
 
• **"A mass" **and **"Amass"** are also correct but different in meaning.
 
• **"Messanger"** is the incorrect word while **"Messenger"** is the correct word.

questions.question:
**The following sentence has been split into four segments. Identify the segment that contains a spelling error.**

They need to / wave the participation / fees for people / with disabilities.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is: "**Wave the participation**".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The correct spelling is "**waive**", which means to cancel or refrain from enforcing something.

 
 
• **Example**: *The school decided to waive the late fee for students who submitted their assignments a day after the deadline.*
 
 
 
• "**Wave**" is a different word that refers to a gesture or a disturbance in a body of water.
 
 
• **Example 1**: *As a sign of greeting, she gave a friendly wave to her neighbour across the street.*
 
• **Example 2**: *The strong wind caused a massive wave on the surface of the ocean, creating a spectacular sight.*
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is **option 1**.

**Corrected sentence**: *They need to waive the participation fees for people with disabilities.*

questions.question:
**The following sentence has been split into four segments. Identify the segment that contains a spelling error.**

According to a report / every day / thousands of animals / are slautered.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is: "**are slautered**".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 

 
• The correct spelling is "**slaughtered**", with the letter "**u**" after the "**g**".
 
• This is a common spelling mistake, as the word is pronounced with a silent "**u**".
 
• **Slaughtered **means the killing of animals, especially for food, or the killing of a large number of people or animals in a brutal or violent manner. (जानवरों की हत्या, विशेषकर भोजन के लिए, या क्रूर या हिंसक तरीके से बड़ी संख्या में लोगों या जानवरों की हत्या)
 
 
• **Example**: *The farmer slaughtered the chickens for fresh meat.*
 
 
 
• The sentence should read "**are slaughtered**" instead of "are slautered".
 
• The error is a spelling mistake, not a grammatical one.

Therefore, the correct answer is **option 2**.
